#!/bin/bash
set -uo pipefail

echo '============================================'
echo '        ClassicUs Update Installer'
echo '============================================'
echo ''
echo 'Waiting for the game to close...'

: 'Wait on the real PID. Matching by name used to catch unrelated processes (and could'
: 'miss the game entirely), and giving up too early meant copying over a binary that was'
: 'still mapped - which fails with ETXTBSY, Text file busy.'
GAME_PID={5}
WAIT_ATTEMPTS=0
while [ "$WAIT_ATTEMPTS" -lt 60 ]; do
    if [ "$GAME_PID" -gt 0 ]; then
        kill -0 "$GAME_PID" 2>/dev/null || break
    else
        : 'No PID available - fall back to the old name match.'
        pgrep -f "{0}" > /dev/null 2>&1 || break
    fi
    WAIT_ATTEMPTS=$((WAIT_ATTEMPTS + 1))
    sleep 1
done

if [ "$WAIT_ATTEMPTS" -ge 60 ]; then
    echo 'Game still running after 60s. Proceeding anyway...'
fi

: 'Give the kernel a moment to release the executable mapping after exit.'
sleep 1

echo ''
echo 'Installing update...'
echo "Source: {1}"
echo "Destination: {2}"
echo ''

COPY_OK=0
LAST_ERR=''

: 'Up to 3 attempts: a lingering mapping clears within a couple of seconds, and retrying'
: 'is far better than telling the player the update failed when it only needed a moment.'
for ATTEMPT in 1 2 3; do
    if [ "$ATTEMPT" -gt 1 ]; then
        echo ""
        echo "Retrying copy (attempt $ATTEMPT/3)..."
        sleep 2
    fi

    if command -v rsync > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo 'Using rsync...'
        LAST_ERR=$(rsync -a --info=progress2 "{1}" "{2}/" 2>&1) && COPY_OK=1
    else
        echo 'Using cp...'
        LAST_ERR=$(cp -a "{1}". "{2}/" 2>&1) && COPY_OK=1
    fi

    if [ "$COPY_OK" -eq 1 ]; then
        break
    fi

    echo "Copy failed: $LAST_ERR"
done

if [ "$COPY_OK" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo ''
    echo '============================================'
    echo '  ERROR: Update failed!'
    echo '============================================'
    echo ""
    echo "Reason: $LAST_ERR"
    echo ''
    echo 'Some files may not have been copied.'
    echo 'You may need to re-download the game.'
    echo ''
    echo 'Press any key to exit...'
    read -n 1 -r || true
    rm -rf "{4}" 2>/dev/null
    exit 1
fi

: 'Ensure all binaries are executable after copy - the ZIP carries no Unix permission bits.'
find "{2}" -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name '*.txt' ! -name '*.md' ! -name '*.json' ! -name '*.xml' ! -name '*.cfg' ! -name '*.ini' -print0 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r -d '' BIN; do
    chmod +x "$BIN" 2>/dev/null || true
done

: 'Explicitly mark main exe executable'
chmod +x "{3}" 2>/dev/null || true

echo ''
echo '============================================'
echo '         Update successful!'
echo '============================================'
echo ''

: 'Only prompt when a real terminal is attached. On the headless path stdin is /dev/null,'
: 'so read returns EOF instantly, KEY stays empty, and the game would never come back up -'
: 'the update would look like it had closed the game for good. Relaunch automatically there.'
if [ -t 0 ]; then
    echo 'Press L to launch the game, or any other key to exit.'
    KEY=''
    read -n 1 -r KEY || true
    echo ''
else
    echo 'No terminal attached - relaunching the game automatically.'
    KEY='l'
fi

if [ "$KEY" = "l" ] || [ "$KEY" = "L" ]; then
    echo 'Launching game...'
    "{3}" &
fi

echo 'Cleaning up temporary files...'
rm -rf "{4}" 2>/dev/null
echo 'Done.'
